en: Color-tinted vintage roadside scene showing a curved road in a semi‑rural area, with grass verges and several traffic signs. A red van and a light-colored car drive along the road. In the distance are low buildings and a red-brick tower flying national flags. The foreground sign shows a white arrow pointing down to the right. Other road signs include speed limit signs and a directional sign indicating destinations in Sweden.
